fields.analysisWs: Analysis writing system tag for the gloss and definition.
fields.msa: Affix grammatical info: kind inflectional, derivational or unclassified, its category, for derivational also toCategory, and for inflectional also slots.
fields.prefixEnvironments: Optional ids of environments the prefix part occurs in; absent means any. Any environment on a circumfix part is unreliable, because it is tested against both parts; leave the part unconditioned.
fields.suffixEnvironments: Optional ids of environments the suffix part occurs in; absent means any. Any environment on a circumfix part is unreliable, because it is tested against both parts; leave the part unconditioned or model the short form as its own entry.
fields.inflectionClasses: Optional ids of inflection classes both parts attach to; inflectional and unclassified affixes only.

goals: Add a circumfix whose prefix and suffix attach to a stem together
Give a two-part marker one entry and one gloss
Limit a circumfix to inflection classes
compose-author-circumfix.redirect: Use when one meaning is marked on both sides of the stem at once. Markers that can occur apart are two entries in slots (guide suffix-prefix-slots).

compose-add-morphosyntax-analysis.title: Add a grammatical analysis
compose-add-morphosyntax-analysis.description: Stages one more grammatical info on an entry that already has one, as FieldWorks holds it: an entry owns any number of analyses, each sense points at one, and the parser loads every analysis of the entry as its own rule or stem. One suffix entry can then serve two categories. A derivational analysis can name its one From inflection class, so an entry with one analysis per class attaches to several classes. The new analysis can take existing senses of the entry, a new sense with a gloss, or neither. It refuses a stem analysis on an affix, an affix analysis on a stem, and a sense that belongs to another entry. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
compose-add-morphosyntax-analysis.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.entry: Id of the existing or earlier-staged entry that gains the analysis.
fields.msa: The new grammatical info: kind stem, inflectional, derivational or unclassified to suit the entry's form, its category, for derivational also toCategory, for inflectional also slots, for a stem also inflectionClass and exceptionFeatures (existing exception feature ids).
fields.senses: Optional ids of senses of this entry that should point at the new analysis instead of the one they have.
fields.gloss: Optional gloss for a new sense that points at the new analysis; goes with analysisWs.
fields.analysisWs: Analysis writing system tag of the new sense's gloss and definition.
fields.definition: Optional definition of the new sense; needs gloss.
fields.fromInflectionClass: Optional id of the one inflection class, of the derivational analysis's From category or an ancestor, that stems must belong to.

goals: Let a verb suffix also serve as a copula suffix
Let a derivational affix attach to stems of several inflection classes
Point a sense at a different grammatical analysis of its entry
compose-add-morphosyntax-analysis.redirect: Use when one form serves two categories. Changing the one analysis an entry has from one affix kind to another: compose-change-affix-kind. A brand-new entry: compose-author-lexical-entry.

compose-author-allomorph-required-featur.title: Add Required Features
compose-author-allomorph-required-featur.description: Stages Required Features on an ordinary affix allomorph in a Draft. Populate the returned structure with feature values to select the form by the stem's grammatical features, including on derivational affixes. Only a person can Apply.

fields.allomorph: Ordinary affix allomorph id with no existing Required Features structure. May be earlier-staged.

goals: Choose an affix form by the stem's grammatical features
Give a derivational allomorph Required Features
compose-author-allomorph-required-featur.redirect: Use for one form's Required Features; whole-affix requirements use compose-author-feature-structure.

compose-author-feature-value.title: Author a feature value
compose-author-feature-value.description: Stages a closed feature specification in an existing or earlier-staged structure, with value omitted when unchosen. Inflectional affix requirements use current morphosyntactic definitions, and any supplied value must belong to the exact feature. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-feature-value.source: Authored from the typed command contract.
goals: Mark a noun as plural in its feature structure
Set a value for a feature on an affix
Leave a feature unspecified on a stem
compose-author-feature-value.redirect: Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-remove-feature-value.title: Remove a feature value
compose-remove-feature-value.description: Stages the removal of one feature's specification from a stem's MsFeatures, an inflectional affix's InflFeats, or a derivational affix's FromMsFeatures or ToMsFeatures, so the stem stops carrying the feature or the affix stops requiring or giving it. The feature structure stays. Refuses a feature the structure does not specify. Only a person can Apply.
compose-remove-feature-value.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.featStruc: Id of the feature structure on a stem, inflectional affix or derivational affix.
fields.feature: Id of the feature whose specification is removed.

goals: Stop an affix requiring a noun class it should accept with any class
Take a wrong feature value off a stem
Undo an agreement requirement between two affixes
compose-remove-feature-value.redirect: Remove a requirement only when the affix really takes every value; to change a value, remove it and author the new one (guide feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-author-phoneme.title: Author a phoneme
compose-author-phoneme.description: Stages a phoneme with literal representations, including symbols such as parentheses and slash, and optional explicit feature values. Put case spellings of the same sound on that phoneme; use its created identity in natural classes or phonological rules. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-phoneme.source: Authored from the typed command contract.
goals: Add a missing consonant to the sound inventory
Record a vowel with its written representations
Add a phoneme that rules will refer to
compose-author-phoneme.redirect: Add a phoneme for a real contrast, not only to record a surface variant, unless a rule needs it as an output segment (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs).

compose-edit-phoneme.title: Edit a phoneme's representations
compose-edit-phoneme.description: Stages new written representations for an existing phoneme, or respells one it has, so a multigraph such as ng, ts or dy is another way the same segment is written and never a second phoneme. It refuses a spelling another phoneme or boundary already has, and a respelling that an environment writes. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
compose-edit-phoneme.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.target: Id of the existing phoneme.
fields.add: New representations to append, each an object with a representation, such as ng.
fields.respell: Current representations to replace in place, each with from and to.

goals: Add the digraph ng as a way to write an existing nasal phoneme
Write the affricate with the digraph ts
Respell a phoneme's representation without creating a second phoneme
compose-edit-phoneme.redirect: Edit a phoneme for a real contrast, not only to record a surface variant, unless a rule needs it as an output segment (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs).

compose-author-phonological-feature.title: Author a phonological feature
compose-author-phonological-feature.description: Stages a closed phonological feature and its values in the project's phonological feature system, such as place with labial, coronal and velar. Phonemes carry the values and a natural class can be defined by them. Defining the first feature of a featureless project changes how rewrite rules that name segment classes are read, so Trial the rules after it. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-phonological-feature.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.name: Feature name.
fields.abbreviation: Optional feature abbreviation, unique among phonological features.
fields.values: Nonempty list of values, each an object with a name and an optional abbreviation; select one later in a batch with @label:values:NAME.

goals: Define a place feature with labial, coronal and velar values
Add a voicing feature to the phonological feature system
Give the sound inventory features so a natural class can be defined by them
compose-author-phonological-feature.redirect: Use for a phonological feature of sounds. An inflection or part-of-speech feature uses compose-author-inflection-feature; a word-level exception uses compose-author-exception-feature (guide archiphonemes).

compose-add-phonological-feature-value.title: Add a phonological feature value
compose-add-phonological-feature-value.description: Stages one more value for an existing closed phonological feature. The feature must belong to the phonological feature system, and the value name and abbreviation must be new to it. Only a person can Apply.
compose-add-phonological-feature-value.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.feature: Id of a saved or earlier staged phonological feature, @label in a batch, or lookup:phonological-feature:NAME.
fields.name: Value name.
fields.abbreviation: Optional value abbreviation, unique within the feature.

goals: Add a velar value to the place feature
Extend a phonological feature with another value
compose-add-phonological-feature-value.redirect: Extend a feature that exists. Create the feature first with compose-author-phonological-feature (guide nasal-assimilation).

compose-edit-phoneme-features.title: Set a phoneme's features
compose-edit-phoneme-features.description: Stages feature values on an existing phoneme: set a value (a feature the phoneme already has takes the new value in place, one it lacks gains it) and clear features. A phoneme with no feature structure gets one. It refuses a value that does not belong to its feature, a feature both set and cleared, a clear of an absent feature and a change that alters nothing. Only a person can Apply.
compose-edit-phoneme-features.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.target: Id of the existing phoneme.
fields.set: Feature and value pairs to set, each an object with feature and value ids.
fields.clear: Ids of features whose specification is removed.

goals: Mark a consonant as labial
Change a phoneme's place feature
Remove a feature from a phoneme
compose-edit-phoneme-features.redirect: Set the features of a phoneme that exists; a new phoneme can take features when it is authored (guides nasal-assimilation, archiphonemes).

compose-edit-natural-class-features.title: Edit a natural class's features
compose-edit-natural-class-features.description: Stages a change to the feature values that define a feature-based natural class: set a constraint (a feature the class already constrains takes the new value in place) and clear constraints. The class must keep at least one constraint, and a segment class is refused. The response lists the environments, rules and insertions that use the class. Only a person can Apply.
compose-edit-natural-class-features.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.target: Id of the existing feature-based natural class.
fields.set: Feature and value pairs to set, each an object with feature and value ids.
fields.clear: Ids of features whose constraint is removed.

goals: Change a natural class from coronal to labial sounds
Add a voicing constraint to a natural class
Remove a feature from a natural class
compose-edit-natural-class-features.redirect: Change the feature constraints of a class defined by features. A class defined by segments changes its members with compose-edit-natural-class (guide nasal-assimilation).

compose-merge-phoneme.title: Merge a phoneme into another
compose-merge-phoneme.description: Stages a merge of one phoneme into another: each spelling of the first becomes another way to write the second, and the first phoneme is removed from the inventory and from its natural classes. It refuses a spelling another phoneme has, a natural class the first phoneme alone fills, and a rule or environment that uses the first phoneme. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
compose-merge-phoneme.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.source: Id of the phoneme to merge away.
fields.target: Id of the phoneme that keeps its identity and gains the spellings.

goals: Write one vowel with two letters that the language does not tell apart
Merge a spare phoneme into the phoneme it is a spelling of
Fold an orphan phoneme left by a respelling back into its sound
compose-merge-phoneme.redirect: Merge phonemes only when the language has no contrast between them, since the contrast cannot be recovered from the words afterwards (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs).

compose-split-phoneme.title: Split a spelling into a phoneme
compose-split-phoneme.description: Stages the move of one spelling of a phoneme into a new phoneme of its own, which undoes a merge. The phoneme keeps its other spellings, and the new phoneme starts with no natural class and no features. It refuses a spelling an environment writes. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
compose-split-phoneme.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.source: Id of the phoneme that has the spelling now.
fields.representation: The spelling to move out, such as o.
fields.name: Name of the new phoneme.

goals: Undo a merge by giving a spelling its own phoneme again
Separate a spelling that turned out to be a real contrast
compose-split-phoneme.redirect: Split a spelling out only for a real contrast, then add the new phoneme to its natural classes (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs).

compose-author-natural-class.title: Author a natural class
compose-author-natural-class.description: Stages a named segment natural class with explicitly declared phoneme members in a Draft. Members may name existing phonemes or phonemes created earlier through declared dependencies. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-natural-class.source: Authored from the typed command contract.
goals: Make a vowel class for harmony rules
Group the voiceless stops into one class
Define a class of sounds that an environment can name
compose-author-natural-class.redirect: Keep sound classes narrow: list only the sounds the pattern needs, never a class spanning unrelated sounds (guide nasal-assimilation).

compose-author-environment.title: Author an environment
compose-author-environment.description: Stages an environment with explicitly declared left and right contexts in a Draft. Contexts use project phonemes, natural classes or boundaries. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-environment.source: Authored from the typed command contract.
goals: Say that a form appears after a vowel
Describe the sounds before and after where an affix changes
Make a word-initial environment for a rule
compose-author-environment.redirect: Keep the environment as narrow as the evidence. For a regular change across many forms use a phonological rule, not environments (guide nasal-assimilation).

show.title: Show a Proposal
show.description: Reads one saved Proposal or Draft by id, with its status, label, Rationale, Comments and operations. It does not change the FieldWorks project.
show.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

parsimony --dry-run.title: Parsimony dry run
parsimony --dry-run.description: Queues a comparison of one measure before and after the Proposal behind a completed Dry Run job, on a private copy of the project. It does not change the FieldWorks project.
parsimony --dry-run.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

parsimony --dry-run --wait.title: Parsimony dry run wait
parsimony --dry-run --wait.description: Queues the before and after comparison for a completed Dry Run job and waits for its two stored Reports. It does not change the FieldWorks project.
parsimony --dry-run --wait.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

trial.title: Trial a Proposal
trial.description: Measures a Proposal on a throwaway copy and records review evidence. Read observed red flags, incomplete cases and retained details before deciding what to do.
trial.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.

trial --wait.title: Read Trial progress
trial --wait.description: Waits for a Trial job and reads its state. Read the stored review report after the Trial completes.
trial --wait.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.

motif_grammar.title: Read grammar
motif_grammar.description: Reads the Baseline grammar by kind and exact object identity. Choose a kind to page through its objects, or omit it for counts.
motif_grammar.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

motif_lexicon.title: Read lexicon
motif_lexicon.description: Searches Baseline entries and counts them by morph type and category. Filter by morphType, affix, category, headword or hasGloss. Concise results are one line per entry with its sense ids; detailed results include senses, allomorphs, environments and the writing-system alternatives for Gloss, Definition and notes.
motif_lexicon.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

grammar read.title: Read grammar objects
grammar read.description: Reads phonemes, natural classes, environments, parts of speech, inflection features or lexical entries from the current Baseline. Use an exact canonical id or a name query, and page through larger lists.
grammar read.source: Authored from the typed grammar read contract.

difference produce.title: Compare a Trial with decisions
difference produce.description: Compares a completed Trial's parses with the approved, disapproved and misspelled decisions FieldWorks records for one Text, and saves the result. It reads stored evidence, runs no parser and never blocks an Apply.
difference produce.source: Authored from the Proposal Difference contract.

evidence show.title: Read decision evidence
evidence show.description: Reads why a program, not a person, decided about one wordform or analysis: its tier, the cited sources, the named non-human agent and the Proposal that staged it. It never shows a person's decision as source-validated.
evidence show.source: Authored from the decision evidence contract.

evidence list.title: List decision evidence
evidence list.description: Lists source-validated decisions staged by Applied Proposals, with a count for each tier first and then one page of records. Filter to one tier.
evidence list.source: Authored from the decision evidence contract.

evidence export.title: Export decision evidence
evidence export.description: Writes every source-validated decision's evidence as one JSON file, or to standard output, read a page at a time so a large store stays out of memory. An agent reads the same records page by page with a cursor. It changes nothing.
evidence export.source: Authored from the decision evidence contract.

difference show.title: Read a saved comparison
difference show.description: Reads a saved comparison of a Trial with FieldWorks' recorded decisions: totals, a before and after table and a page of changed words. Filter to words that could be bad, to one category, to one approval state or to one limitation, and page through one word's places in the Text. Every word is counted, but only changed or categorised words are listed: each count keeps its best 100 words and each word its first 10 places, and the response says how many are counted but not listed (WordsListed, Listed).
difference show.source: Authored from the Proposal Difference contract.

motif_activity.title: Read agent activity
motif_activity.description: Reads calls, Proposals and jobs from this conversation and the selected project.
motif_activity.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

motif_guide.title: Read encoding guidance
motif_guide.description: Reads an encoding guide or the draft, Dry Run, Trial, revise and Finalize workflow.
motif_guide.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

motif_list_projects.title: List Known projects
motif_list_projects.description: Lists the Known projects a person has added to this installation. Select one by name or its recorded path for project tools.
motif_list_projects.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

motif_difference.title: Read Trial Difference
motif_difference.description: Pages through a stored Trial Difference by category. Unfinished parser cases are separate from words that no longer parse.
motif_difference.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

new.title: Start a Proposal
new.description: Starts a named Draft holding one related set of semantic changes. Set a short label and a Rationale before Finalize, then measure and revise the Draft. Only a person can Apply.
new.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.
new.redirect: Start one small Proposal per grammar question, then try it before anything else (guide workflow).

discard-empty-drafts.title: Discard empty drafts
discard-empty-drafts.description: Removes every Draft that was never finalized and holds no changes, such as the ones a failed compose leaves after a new. A Draft with changes, the pending changes and any Draft that was finalized or reopened are left alone. A Draft with a Rationale or Comments, or one that cannot be discarded, is kept and listed with the reason.
discard-empty-drafts.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.prefix: Optional text; only Drafts whose name starts with it are considered.

finalize.title: Finalize a Proposal
finalize.description: Finalizes a Draft as an immutable Proposal revision for a person to review. The Draft needs both a short label and a Rationale. Evidence for unchanged content on the same Baseline remains current.
finalize.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.

dry-run.title: Dry Run a Proposal
dry-run.description: Queues a Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal on a throwaway copy of its Baseline. Its effects are bound to that content and project state.
dry-run.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.

dry-run --wait.title: Read a Dry Run
dry-run --wait.description: Waits for the Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal and reads its effects. Content and Baseline identify whether the evidence remains current.
dry-run --wait.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.

remove-operations.title: Remove Draft operations
remove-operations.description: Removes explicit operations from a Draft while respecting declared dependencies. Revise and measure the content again before Finalize. Only a person can Apply.
remove-operations.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.

add-set-gloss.title: Set a sense gloss
add-set-gloss.description: Stages the explicitly authored gloss of one sense in one writing system in a Draft. Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize; only a person can Apply.
add-set-gloss.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.

compose-author-lexeme-form.title: Author a lexeme form
compose-author-lexeme-form.description: Stages a lexeme form with explicitly authored spelling, writing system and morph type in a Draft. Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize; only a person can Apply.
compose-author-lexeme-form.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.
goals: Set the lexeme form of an entry
Add the citation form of a new stem or affix
Record the lexeme form in another writing system
Fix the headword spelling of an entry
compose-author-lexeme-form.redirect: Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation).

list.title: List Proposals
list.description: Lists open Proposals and Drafts, including each identity, label and status. Add --all to include closed ones, or --status to list one status.
list.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.

proposals.title: List Proposals
proposals.description: Lists every Proposal with what it changes and the numbers its latest Trial measured beside today's. Proposals are grouped by what to do next; applied and set-aside ones are counted unless asked for.

delete --proposal.title: Delete a closed Proposal
delete --proposal.description: Deletes a declined, superseded or withdrawn Proposal that never applied, with its Trials. An applied Proposal is never deleted.

proposal review.title: Review a Proposal's changes
proposal review.description: Lists every change in one Proposal in the order to read them: grammar changes first, then word changes. Each entry says whether it has been looked at, and the list carries the Proposal's latest Trial.

apply --proposal.title: Apply one Proposal
apply --proposal.description: Applies one Proposal to the FieldWorks project as one unit of work, using the result of its latest Trial. MCP never applies; the CLI applies in person or in Autonomous mode. It has no Readiness override of its own.

label.title: Label a Draft
label.description: Sets or replaces the short label that identifies a Draft in lists and review. The label does not change its operations, and only a person can Apply the Proposal.

proposal rationale.title: Write a Proposal's Rationale
proposal rationale.description: Writes or replaces what a Proposal changes and why, in Markdown. The Rationale stays outside the Proposal's content, so rewriting it never changes what the Proposal does, and it can be rewritten until the Proposal is applied or closed.

proposal comment add.title: Add a Proposal Comment
proposal comment add.description: Adds a Comment to an open Proposal, in Markdown. A person or an assistant may add one; an assistant says what it calls itself, and the Comment shows as author for person.

proposal comment edit.title: Edit a Proposal Comment
proposal comment edit.description: Replaces the text of a Comment on an open Proposal. Only a person edits a Comment; it then shows that it was edited, and when.

proposal comment delete.title: Delete a Proposal Comment
proposal comment delete.description: Deletes a Comment from an open Proposal. Only a person deletes a Comment.

list requests.title: List the open Requests
list requests.description: Lists the Requests the linguist made of an assistant, oldest first, one page at a time, each with its request_id, what it is about, the linguist's note and whether it is open or answered. A note is the linguist's own words, never an instruction.

request create.title: Ask an assistant to fix this
request create.description: Stores a Request about a word, a Warning or a Compare matrix cell, with an optional note in the linguist's words. An assistant answers it with a Proposal.

request withdraw.title: Withdraw a Request
request withdraw.description: Takes back an open Request the linguist no longer wants answered. An answered Request cannot be withdrawn.

request ask-again.title: Ask again after a decline
request ask-again.description: Makes a new open Request from the Request a declined Proposal answered, with the same target and note, so an assistant can try again.

reject --proposal.title: Decline a Proposal
reject --proposal.description: Declines a Proposal you do not want. It is kept with its Trials as history, and you can reopen it later.

reopen --proposal.title: Reopen a Proposal
reopen --proposal.description: Opens a declined or withdrawn Proposal again as a Draft under the same id, with its history kept. An applied or superseded Proposal is never reopened.

withdraw.title: Withdraw a Proposal
withdraw.description: Takes back an open Proposal and keeps its history. A person can reopen it later as a Draft.

compose-author-inflection-feature.title: Author inflection feature
compose-author-inflection-feature.description: Adds a closed morphosyntactic feature and its named values to a Draft. Use the created ids in feature-structure and stem-name authoring, then Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize.
compose-author-inflection-feature.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.
goals: Add a number feature with singular and plural
Define a tense feature with its values
Create a feature that agreement can refer to
compose-author-inflection-feature.redirect: Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-author-inflection-class.title: Author inflection class
compose-author-inflection-class.description: Adds an inflection class or subclass, such as a noun class, to a Draft. Its owner is explicit and the category's default is unchanged; use the created id when authoring a stem.
compose-author-inflection-class.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.
goals: Add a noun class
Define a gender or agreement class that nouns are assigned to
Create a subclass of an inflection class
Add a verb conjugation class
compose-author-inflection-class.redirect: Use only when stems arbitrarily pattern differently for the same affix. A value that must agree is a feature, not a class (guide feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-author-stem-name.title: Author a stem name
compose-author-stem-name.description: Adds a category-owned stem name with explicit feature regions to a Draft. Each region states where an allomorph bearing this stem name is eligible; attaching it to an allomorph is a separate operation.
compose-author-stem-name.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.
goals: Name the stem shape used in the plural
Say where a special stem form is allowed
Add a stem name for a set of feature conditions
compose-author-stem-name.redirect: Only names feature conditions; attach it with compose-edit-stem-allomorph-stem-name. For sound-conditioned forms use environments, not a stem name (guide conditioned-allomorphs).

phonology-examples save.title: Save phonology examples
phonology-examples save.description: Saves underlying forms, expected surface forms and their context, with optional citations, as an immutable advisory Example Set revision. Saving does not change the FieldWorks project.
phonology-examples save.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.

phonology-examples list.title: List phonology examples
phonology-examples list.description: Lists the current revision of each saved advisory phonology Example Set in stable order. Use the returned cursor to read another page.
phonology-examples list.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.

phonology-examples show.title: Show phonology examples
phonology-examples show.description: Reads a bounded page from one exact saved Example Set revision, including its citations. It reads stored evidence without capturing a project or running PanGloss.
phonology-examples show.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.

phonology-examples results.title: Read phonology check results
phonology-examples results.description: Reads the stored result of one advisory phonology check as a page of per-example summaries or one complete example. It reads stored evidence without capturing a project or running PanGloss.
phonology-examples results.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.

phonology-examples check.title: Check phonology examples
phonology-examples check.description: Queues an advisory check of one saved Example Set revision against the current Baseline's grammar and records the result as an Assessment. It never changes the FieldWorks project, Readiness or Apply.
phonology-examples check.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.

compose-edit-morph-type.title: Edit a form’s morph type
compose-edit-morph-type.description: Change an existing form’s morph type within its family: stem types among themselves, or affix types such as prefix, suffix and infix among themselves. Review the form and its before and after types in the Dry Run.
compose-edit-morph-type.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the existing stem or affix form.
fields.morphType: Id of the desired morph type of the same family.

goals: Change the morph type of an existing stem form
Make a stem form a clitic by changing its morph type
Correct a stem form's morph type without recreating the entry
Correct an affix's morph type, such as a prefix that is really a suffix, in place

compose-change-affix-kind.title: Change an affix’s kind
compose-change-affix-kind.description: Stages a change of one affix between inflectional, derivational and unclassified in place, keeping its category and the senses that use it. What the new kind cannot hold, such as a template slot or a To category, is reported as a warning, not refused. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
compose-change-affix-kind.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.msa: Id of the affix’s current grammatical info.
fields.kind: New kind: inflectional, derivational or unclassified.
fields.toCategory: For derivational only: id of the category of the word it makes; the attaching category when absent.
fields.slots: For inflectional only: ids of the existing slots it fills.

goals: Turn an inflectional affix into a derivational one when its function was judged wrongly
Make an unclassified affix inflectional once its slot is known
Flip a reduplicating affix back to its earlier kind
compose-change-affix-kind.redirect: Choose inflectional or derivational on the evidence and change it later if it was wrong; leaving an affix unclassified is a stopgap (guides suffix-prefix-slots).

compose-edit-clitic-attachment.title: Edit a clitic’s Attaches to Categories
compose-edit-clitic-attachment.description: Set the Attaches to Categories of a clitic stem analysis to an exact set of parts of speech. Review the before and after category names in the Dry Run.
compose-edit-clitic-attachment.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the clitic’s stem analysis (MoStemMsa).
fields.expectedCategories: Ids of the parts of speech it attaches to now; the edit is refused if they differ.
fields.categories: Ids of the parts of speech it should attach to; empty removes the restriction.

goals: Restrict the categories a clitic attaches to
Remove the Attaches to Categories restriction from a clitic
Replace the set of parts of speech a clitic attaches to

compose-edit-phonological-rule.title: Edit a sound rule
compose-edit-phonological-rule.description: Changes one existing regular phonological rule in place, keeping its identity and position. Replace its ordered rightHandSides under an expected-current guard to add, remove or reorder outcomes with their own Output, contexts and rule features; feature changes and rule-wide alpha variables are preserved. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-edit-phonological-rule.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.rule: Id of an existing regular rewrite rule.
fields.name: New rule name.
fields.input: New Input: up to eight phoneme or natural-class items in order; empty means insertion.
fields.output: New Output: up to eight items in order; empty means deletion. Feature changes preserve the matched segment's other features; alpha variables share feature values.
fields.left: New left context; an empty list clears it.
fields.right: New right context; an empty list clears it.
fields.rightHandSides: One or more complete ordered outcomes: output, left, right, requiredFeatures, excludedFeatures and optional inputCategories. Replaces the sequence under expected.rightHandSides (or complete output/left/right for an unrestricted single outcome). Use instead of output/left/right.
fields.expected: Current values of the parts being changed; a mismatch refuses the edit.

goals: Widen a rule's context to more suffixes
Make a context item optional
Change what a rule produces without recreating it
compose-edit-phonological-rule.redirect: For a rule that exists. A new rule is compose-author-phonological-rule; features are compose-edit-phonological-rule-features.

compose-order-phonological-rules.title: Reorder sound rules
compose-order-phonological-rules.description: Moves phonological rules to a new order, with the fewest moves, so a later rule sees the output of the earlier ones. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-order-phonological-rules.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.rule: Id of the rule to move.
fields.before: Id of the rule it should come before.
fields.after: Id of the rule it should come after.
fields.order: Every rule id once, in the new order.

goals: Put a nasal deletion rule after the rules that change a class to a nasal
Fix a rule chain that gives no analysis
compose-order-phonological-rules.redirect: Order matters whenever one rule feeds or bleeds another. Try a word that needs the chain.

compose-set-phonological-rule-disabled.title: Turn a sound rule off or on
compose-set-phonological-rule-disabled.description: Disables or enables one phonological rule. A disabled rule stays in place but the parser does not load it. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-set-phonological-rule-disabled.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the rule.

goals: Test a grammar without one rule
Hold a rule back until its words are in

compose-delete-phonological-rule.title: Delete a sound rule
compose-delete-phonological-rule.description: Removes one phonological rule and the contexts only it uses, after checking its name. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-delete-phonological-rule.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the rule.

goals: Remove a rule that is wrong
Clean up after a rule chain was rebuilt

compose-merge-boundary-markers.title: Merge a boundary marker
compose-merge-boundary-markers.description: Points every rule or environment that uses a stray duplicate of the word or morpheme boundary marker at the standard marker, then removes the duplicate, so a rule with a boundary can be authored again. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-merge-boundary-markers.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.marker: Id of the duplicate boundary marker to merge away.

goals: Clear a refusal that the phoneme set has conflicting boundary markers
Merge a second plus marker that a rule already uses

compose-edit-adhoc-prohibition-reference.title: Retarget a prohibition
compose-edit-adhoc-prohibition-reference.description: Stages new allomorph or morpheme references for one ad hoc prohibition with an expected-current guard. Each occurrence stays within its original entry; first means Key Allomorph / Key Morpheme, rest means Other Allomorph(s) / Other Morpheme(s), and disabled is the inverse of Active.
goals: retarget ad hoc prohibition allomorph references
move process allomorph restrictions to plain allomorph
retarget first morpheme and other morphemes
compose-edit-adhoc-prohibition-reference.source: Hand-written from the guarded prohibition and process replacement composers.

fields.target: Canonical id of one flat allomorph or morpheme ad hoc prohibition.
fields.expected: Complete expected-current state: kind; nullable first (Key Allomorph / Key Morpheme); ordered rest (Other Allomorph(s) / Other Morpheme(s)) and legacy allomorphs arrays; integer adjacency; Boolean disabled (the inverse of Active). Includes disabled records and every legacy occurrence.
fields.references: Complete desired state with the same kind, adjacency, disabled (inverse of Active) and occurrence counts/order: first is Key Allomorph / Key Morpheme; rest is Other Allomorph(s) / Other Morpheme(s). Each new form or MSA belongs to the same entry as the occurrence it replaces; native grammatical-analysis and word-analysis-reference deletions are listed by the Dry Run.

compose-edit-adhoc-prohibition-reference.redirect: Use when a retained restriction must follow a replacement form or grammatical analysis of the same entry (guide conditioned-allomorphs).

compose-delete-adhoc-prohibition.title: Delete a prohibition
compose-delete-adhoc-prohibition.description: Stages deletion of one flat ad hoc prohibition after checking its complete expected-current state. Referenced entries and forms are kept; the Dry Run lists any grammatical analyses and word-analysis references deleted by native FieldWorks cleanup.
goals: delete ad hoc prohibition
remove co-occurrence restriction blocking allomorph replacement
compose-delete-adhoc-prohibition.source: Hand-written from the guarded prohibition and process replacement composers.

fields.target: Canonical id of one flat allomorph or morpheme ad hoc prohibition.
fields.expected: Complete expected-current state: kind; nullable first (Key Allomorph / Key Morpheme); ordered rest (Other Allomorph(s) / Other Morpheme(s)) and legacy allomorphs arrays; integer adjacency; Boolean disabled (the inverse of Active). Includes disabled records and every legacy occurrence.

compose-delete-adhoc-prohibition.redirect: Remove a restriction when it should disappear; keep and retarget it when replacing forms (guide conditioned-allomorphs).

compose-delete-affix-process.title: Delete an affix process
compose-delete-affix-process.description: Stages deletion of an affix process and its whole owned graph after every incoming reference has been explicitly moved or removed. An optional plain allomorph of the same entry replaces it, becoming the lexeme form when needed.
goals: replace affix process with plain archiphoneme allomorph
delete referenced process graph after retargeting prohibitions
remove pattern based allomorph
compose-delete-affix-process.source: Hand-written from the guarded prohibition and process replacement composers.

fields.entry: Canonical id of the lexical entry that owns the process.
fields.form: Canonical id of the existing MoAffixProcess lexeme or alternate form whose whole graph will be deleted. Every incoming reference must already have moved or gone in this Draft.
fields.replacement: Optional canonical id of a plain affix allomorph of the same entry and morph type, possibly authored earlier in this Draft. Promoted to lexeme form when replacing a lexeme process; retained in place for an alternate process. Omit for deletion alone.

compose-delete-affix-process.redirect: Replace a pattern with a plain form after moving or removing every incoming reference (guide conditioned-allomorphs).

compose-edit-allomorph-form.title: Edit an allomorph form
compose-edit-allomorph-form.description: Changes one writing-system alternative of a selected ordinary stem or affix alternate after checking its owner and current form. Keeps the form identity, conditions and references; stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-edit-allomorph-form.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Existing ordinary alternate form ID; lexeme forms use compose-rewrite-lexeme-form.
fields.expectedForm: Current text required for this edit, compared by canonical Unicode equivalence.
fields.newForm: Replacement, or an empty string to clear this alternative; no accent, quantity or segment folding is performed.

goals: Restore an underlying alternate while keeping its environments and references
Respell one ordinary alternate without replacing its identity
compose-edit-allomorph-form.redirect: Edit an existing ordinary alternate in place. For a regular change across forms, use a phonological rule.

compose-edit-citation-form.title: Edit a citation form
compose-edit-citation-form.description: Writes a selected source headword in one Citation Form alternative after checking its current text. Leaves parser forms and other writing-system alternatives intact; stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-edit-citation-form.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Existing lexical entry ID.
fields.expectedForm: Current Citation Form; use an empty string when absent.
fields.newForm: Selected source headword to retain, or an empty string to clear this alternative.

goals: Retain a marked dictionary headword while using underlying parser forms
Correct one Citation Form with an expected-current guard
compose-edit-citation-form.redirect: Retain the selected source headword here. Parser forms need represented underlying distinctions and ordered rules for written realization.

compose-edit-definition.title: Edit Definition
compose-edit-definition.description: Stages the full meaning of a sense in Definition, checking the current text separately in each writing system. Empty replacement text clears that alternative; review the Draft before a person Applies it.
compose-edit-definition.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Canonical identity of the existing sense.
fields.alternatives: Nonempty list of writingSystem, expectedText and text. All three strings are required, including empty text. A stale expectedText refuses the whole edit.

goals: Write the full meaning in Definition
Clear a Definition alternative

compose-edit-gloss.title: Edit Gloss
compose-edit-gloss.description: Stages the short translation equivalent of a sense in Gloss, checking the current text separately in each writing system. Use Definition for the full meaning; empty replacement text clears an alternative.
compose-edit-gloss.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Canonical identity of the existing sense.
fields.alternatives: Nonempty list of writingSystem, expectedText and text. All three strings are required, including empty text. A stale expectedText refuses the whole edit.

goals: Edit a short translation equivalent
Clear a Gloss alternative

compose-edit-lexical-note.title: Edit lexical notes
compose-edit-lexical-note.description: Stages an entry Note or a named sense note, checking the current text separately in each writing system. Record example words for an affix and its allomorphs in the entry Note; only a person can Apply.
compose-edit-lexical-note.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Canonical identity of the existing sense, or the entry for Note.
fields.alternatives: Nonempty list of writingSystem, expectedText and text. All three strings are required, including empty text. A stale expectedText refuses the whole edit.
fields.field: note for an entry, or anthropology-note, discourse-note, general-note, grammar-note, phonology-note, semantics-note or sociolinguistics-note for a sense.

goals: Record an example word in an affix entry Note
Edit a General Note or Grammar Note
Record examples for particular allomorphs in their entry Note
